---
title: "Crypto Markets"
author: "Mayah"
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)

prices <- read_parquet("data/daily_prices.parquet")
metadata <- read_parquet("data/coin_metadata.parquet")
categories <- read_parquet("data/categories.parquet")

crypto <- prices |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date_raw)) |>
  left_join(metadata, by = "coin_id") |>
  left_join(select(categories, -description), by = "category_id")
```

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)

crypto |>
  filter(coin_id == "btc") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = price_usd)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Bitcoin Daily Price",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Price (USD)"
  )
```

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)

category_market_caps <- crypto |>
  group_by(date, category_name) |>
  summarize(category_market_cap_usd = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(category_name = fct_reorder(
    category_name,
    category_market_cap_usd,
    .fun = median,
    .desc = TRUE
  ))

events <- tibble(
  event = c("Luna/UST crash", "FTX collapse"),
  start = as.Date(c("2022-05-07", "2022-11-08")),
  end = as.Date(c("2022-05-12", "2022-11-11"))
)

category_market_caps |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = category_market_cap_usd, fill = category_name)) +
  geom_area(position = "fill") +
  geom_rect(
    data = events,
    aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = 0, ymax = 1),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "grey20",
    alpha = 0.18,
    color = "grey20",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = events,
    aes(x = start + (end - start) / 2, y = 0.7, label = event),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    angle = 90,
    color = "white",
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 3,
    vjust = 1.1
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  labs(
    title = "How Crypto Market Capitalization Is Distributed",
    subtitle = "Daily share of total market capitalization by category; each day sums to 100%.",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Share of total market cap",
    fill = "Category",
    caption = "Source: daily_prices.parquet, coin_metadata.parquet, and categories.parquet."
  )
```
